name: Car saint

aliases: gzi · zi bead · 天珠 · tian zhu · heaven's bead

aliases: higa · cigua · fig hand · mano fica · manus fica · fig sign amulet

name: Fu talisman

aliases: lucky shoes · rally cap · lucky number · rally chew · rally shoe · lucky jersey

name: Gorgoneion

period: documented from the era of the West African Muslim scholarly networks; carried to the Americas with Atlantic slavery
